description: A condition carries its value: a rule whose condition has none is refused at load at its value path, naming it (policy_format.md 2.23; HTL-45 d0640d7a; gap 322). Through 2.22 TypeScript loaded a condition with no value wherever the operator's operand kind took any value (`equals`, `not_equals`, `contains`, `not_contains`); this `equals` never matched.
